story.iWant: practice typing code snippets in various programming languages
story.soThat: I can improve my coding speed and accuracy with syntax-specific practice
story.tasks:
Task 1: Syntax Highlighting Integration (AC: 1, 4) - Integrate syntax highlighting library for multiple languages - Implement code snippet rendering with proper highlighting - Add support for language-specific syntax detection - Optimize highlighting performance for real-time typing
Task 2: Programming Language Support (AC: 1, 2, 3) - Create programming language selection interface - Build code snippet database for multiple languages - Implement language-specific character frequency analysis - Add difficulty levels for code complexity classification
Task 3: Code-Specific Features (AC: 2, 5) - Implement special programming character emphasis - Create code-specific character frequency mapping - Add programming language character sets - Develop code-specific accuracy metrics
Task 4: Code Mode UI Components (AC: 1-6) - Create CodeMode component extending TypingArea - Implement language selection and difficulty controls - Add code snippet display with syntax highlighting - Create code-specific metrics display
Task 5: Code Database and Content (AC: 1, 3) - Create code snippet database structure - Implement difficulty classification algorithm for code - Add support for multiple programming languages - Ensure code quality and variety in snippets
Task 6: Code-Specific Performance Tracking (AC: 6) - Implement code-specific typing metrics - Create separate analytics for code mode performance - Add language-specific performance tracking - Develop code proficiency progress indicators
Task 7: Testing and Quality Assurance (All ACs) - Unit tests for syntax highlighting integration - Unit tests for language-specific character handling - Integration tests with existing typing engine - Performance testing for code snippet loading

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Given I select Code mode, when I choose a programming language then code snippets are displayed with syntax highlighting 2. Given I select Code mode, when I choose a programming language then programming-specific characters are emphasized 3. Given I select Code mode, when I choose a programming language then difficulty levels match code complexity 4. Given I practice with code, when I type then syntax highlighting helps identify different code elements 5. Given I practice with code, when I type then special programming characters are included in practice 6. Given I practice with code, when I type then my coding typing performance is tracked separately

Existing mode selection patterns to extend for programming language selection within code mode
Existing code mode implementation to enhance with syntax highlighting and advanced features

story-context.constraints: - Must maintain existing typing latency (<50ms performance requirement) - Syntax highlighting should be performant and non-blocking - Code snippet database should be optimized for quick language filtering - Character emphasis should work seamlessly with existing typing validation - Extend existing TypingArea component to maintain consistency - Use established Firebase patterns for storing code snippets and progress - Follow existing component organization patterns from src/components/ - Leverage existing ModeSelector component patterns for language selection

ideas.idea: Test syntax highlighting renders correctly for JavaScript, Python, Java, C++, HTML, CSS
Test special programming characters are emphasized (brackets, operators, symbols)
Test difficulty levels properly classify code complexity (beginner, intermediate, advanced)
Test code-specific performance tracking stores separate metrics from other modes
Test language selection interface updates code snippets correctly
Test typing latency remains <50ms with syntax highlighting enabled
